handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Memory system has three layers: (1) Pi SessionManager — JSONL conversation history at ~/.pi/agent/sessions/, tree-structured with CustomEntry for extension state; (2) ASFDK UnifiedStateManager — in-memory component state coordination with access control, persistence is TODO-stubbed; (3) Sleepwalker ContinuityManager — actual disk persistence via .swp_storage/<user_id>.json for cross-session emotional continuity. The harness itself has no memory system — it only passes sessionId to the foundation. Key gap: UnifiedStateManager and TOIOTOIIntegration both have TODO-stubbed persistence.
